title: JointLight: Human-Centric Video Relighting with Asynchronous RGB-Irradiance Joint Modeling
title_zh: JointLight：基于异步RGB-辐照度联合建模的以人为中心的视频重打光

paragraphs.en: JointLight通过RGB与辐照度异步联合建模实现可控的以人为中心视频重打光，并构建多照明合成数据集。 Understanding and modeling light transport in human-centric scenes is a longstanding challenge. While recent progress in diffusion models has boosted research in relighting, precise illumination control still lags, primarily due to the scarcity of diverse, high-quality, precisely labeled video relighting datasets. Existing end-to-end relighting approaches model light transport implicitly through neural networks, which substantially complicates controllability. In contrast, some works resort to path-traced irradiance cues as an explicit blueprint for light transport. However, such constructed irradiance cues are prone to artifacts and hinder generative quality when directly used as control signals. With the key observation that noise corruption removes high-frequency artifacts and preserves low-frequency light transport, we introduce an asynchronous joint-modeling paradigm that facilitates fine-grained illumination control. During two-stage training, we force the model to jointly denoise RGB and ground-truth irradiance frames with separate timesteps scheduling. A domain matching strategy is applied to the second stage to bridge the domain gap between irradiance cues and ground-truth irradiance maps. At inference time, we introduce an asynchronous hijacked generation pipeline that facilitates flexible illumination control. For training data, we develop a multi-illumination high-quality synthetic video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model exhibits robust generalization to real- world scenarios and outperforms prior approaches in both lighting fidelity and generative quality. The code and dataset will be publicly released.
paragraphs.zh: JointLight通过RGB与辐照度的异步联合建模实现可控的以人为中心视频重打光，并构建了多照明合成数据集。理解并建模以人为中心场景中的光传输是一个长期存在的挑战。 尽管扩散模型的最新进展推动了重打光研究，但精确的照明控制仍然滞后，主要原因是缺乏多样化、高质量、精确标注的视频重打光数据集。 现有的端到端重打光方法通过神经网络隐式地建模光传输，这极大地增加了可控性的难度。 相比之下，一些工作采用路径追踪的辐照度线索作为光传输的显式蓝图。 然而，这样构建的辐照度线索容易产生伪影，并且当直接用作控制信号时会损害生成质量。 基于噪声破坏能够去除高频伪影并保留低频光传输这一关键观察，我们提出了一种异步联合建模范式，以实现细粒度的照明控制。 在两阶段训练中，我们强制模型使用各自的时间步调度对RGB帧和真值辐照度帧进行联合去噪。 在第二阶段，我们应用域匹配策略来弥合辐照度线索与真值辐照度图之间的域差距。 在推理时，我们引入了一种异步劫持生成管线，以实现灵活的照明控制。 在训练数据方面，我们使用强大的游戏引擎构建了一个带有成对辐照度图的多照明高质量合成视频数据集。 仅在该数据集上训练，我们的模型便展现出对真实世界场景的鲁棒泛化能力，并在光照保真度和生成质量两方面均优于已有方法。 代码和数据集将会公开发布。
